**Calculation (FY2024, as reported in Meta's FY2024 10-K):**

- Revenue: $164,501 million [DOC-1]
- Income from operations: $69,380 million [DOC-1]
- Operating margin = $69,380 ÷ $164,501 = **42.2%**

Both inputs come from the same consolidated statement of income for the same fiscal period (year ended December 31, 2024), so no comparability adjustments are needed. (For reference, the same statement implies FY2023 margin of $46,751 ÷ $134,902 = 34.7% and FY2022 of $28,944 ÷ $116,609 = 24.8% [DOC-1], though the question asks only about FY2024.)

ANSWER: ~42.2% (operating income of $69,380M on revenue of $164,501M)
